text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prevailing over a fierce battle, Sirius 
Symboli emerged as the victor of the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Catching Symboli Rudolf's gaze for a brief 
moment, Sirius Symboli realizes her true 
feelings: just like in the old days, she 
simply wanted her to look at "her."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having cast aside her doubts and reclaimed 
her own light, she declared she would 
prove herself in GI races to prepare for 
heading overseas. First, she set her 
sights on the Osaka Hai.
